newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA SUGAR RANGED ON LIMITED SUPPLIES, LOW BUYING.
newsitem.headline: INDIA SUGAR RANGED ON LIMITED SUPPLIES, LOW BUYING.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady in a narrow range on the local market on Friday as consumer buying stayed slow despite approaching festivals though limited supplies kept offerings at a low ebb, dealers said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,490/1,500 rupees per quintal as was sugar M-30 at 1,515/1,545 rupees per quintal.
"Limited mill offerings due to increased outstation buying kept inflow of sugar from mills to the market restricted," on broker said.

Sugar mill delivery looked up on fresh outstation buying ahead of festivals. In the mill delivery sugar S-30 moved up to 1,420/1,435 rupees per quintal from 1,415/1,420 rupees while sugar M-30 rose by 5/10 rupees at 1,440/1,455 rupees per quintal.
